_comment: Startup model recommendations, chosen by how much memory a machine has.
Edit this file to change what Brazier suggests. A copy placed at
recommendations can be updated without rebuilding the application.
Every entry carries an `id`. Changing the id is what tells Brazier the
recommendation for that category has changed, which is what triggers the
offer to swap for anyone who installed the previous one through the welcome
flow. Correcting a label or a note without changing the model should leave
`quant: by_memory` resolves at display time against the repository's real
file sizes: the best of Q8_0, Q6_K, Q5_K_M, Q4_K_M, Q3_K_M, Q2_K that fits
in 60% of usable memory, preferring Unsloth's UD-*_XL build of that rung.
The remaining 40% is left for the KV cache, the OS, and everything else.
A tier with no `agent` entry uses its `text` one. A category set to null is
